anomalies.observed: The SWD programming connector J2 is wired as follows: pin 2 (SWDIO) on NET0002, pin 3 (SWCLK) on NET0012, pin 4 (~RESET) on NET0013, pin 6 (SWO) on NET0014. On the MCU, NET0002 is the PB3/SWO net, NET0012 is the PB14/DISP_SDA net, NET0014 is the NRST net, and the intended SWDIO/SWCLK pins PA13 (pin 46) and PA14 (pin 49) are unconnected.
anomalies.expected: J2.2 (SWDIO) should connect to PA13 (pin 46), J2.3 (SWCLK) to PA14 (pin 49), J2.4 (~RESET) to NRST, and J2.6 (SWO) to PB3 (pin 55).

evidence.quote: J2 pin labels: NET0002, NET0012, NET0013, NET0014 under SWDIO, SWCLK, RESET, SWO (root sheet, Programming (SWD))
J1 ... Its pins are VCC, GND, ~{RESET}, SWCLK, SWDIO, SWO — a standard ARM debug/programming interface

anomalies.impact: The board cannot be programmed or debugged over SWD because the connector's SWDIO/SWCLK are not connected to the MCU's PA13/PA14. Additionally, SWO is tied to NRST and SWCLK is tied to the display SDA line, which can corrupt I2C and reset behaviour when a programmer is attached.

anomalies.observed: The NFC_IC sheet symbol pins connect to the MCU as follows: NET0018 (SDA from U4 pin 5) → PB10 (pin 29); NET0005 (SCL from U4 pin 3) → PB9 (pin 62); NET0011 (FD from U4 pin 4) → PB8 (pin 61).
anomalies.expected: NFC_SDA should connect to PB9 (pin 62), NFC_SCL to PB8 (pin 61), and NFC_INT (FD) to PA6 (pin 22), per the specification.

evidence.quote: NFC_IC sheet symbol pins NET0011, NET0005, NET0018 routed to MCU pins 61, 62, 29 (root sheet, NFC block)
NFC_SDA net: U2 pin 62 (PB9) — R1 (10 kΩ) to VCC — U3 pin 5 (SDA); NFC_SCL net: U2 pin 61 (PB8) — R2 (10 kΩ) to VCC — U3 pin 3 (SCL); NFC_INT net: U2 pin 22 (PA6) — R3 (10 kΩ) to VCC — U3 pin 4 (FD)

anomalies.impact: The NFC tag IC is connected to the wrong MCU pins, so firmware written for the intended pinout will not communicate with the NFC IC. NFC field-detect is also not on the intended PA6 input.

anomalies.observed: The TSC electrode path is: PB7 (pin 59, NET0004) → R5 (1 kΩ) → A3 pin 1 (BTN). The TSC sampling capacitor path is: PB5 (pin 57, NET0007) → C2 (22 nF) → GND.
anomalies.expected: PB5 (pin 57) should be the electrode path via the 1 kΩ series resistor to BTN, and PB7 (pin 59) should be the TSC sampling capacitor path to the 22 nF capacitor to GND.

evidence.quote: TSC block: NET0004 → R5 (1k) → A3 BTN; NET0007 → C2 (22n) → GND (root sheet, Capacitive Touch Button (TSC))
TSC_G2_IO2: U2 pin 57 (PB5) — R8 (1 kΩ series resistor) — A2 pin "BTN"; TSC_G2_IO4: U2 pin 59 (PB7) — C14 (22 nF to GND)

anomalies.impact: The electrode and sampling capacitor are swapped relative to the intended design, so the touch button will not work with firmware configured for the reference pinout.

parsed.summary: The schematic contains several connectivity deviations from the intended design: the SWD programming connector is wired to unrelated nets (including NRST and display SDA) instead of the MCU SWDIO/SWCLK pins, the NFC interface is shifted onto PB8/PB9/PB10 rather than the specified PB8/PB9/PA6, and the TSC electrode and sampling capacitor are swapped between PB5 and PB7. These would prevent programming/debugging and break the NFC and touch functions unless the hardware or firmware is reworked.
